priorStatuses.title: Remove the message listener during cleanup

findings.title: [P2] Restore listener removal in the returned cleanup function
findings.body: Calling the function returned by `attach` no longer unregisters the `"message"` handler. Consumers that dispose or reattach handlers will continue receiving messages through stale callbacks, accumulate duplicate listeners, and retain associated state in memory.

findings.title: [P2] Remove the message listener during cleanup
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current src/socket.ts:2 registers handler with socket.on("message", handler), while the cleanup returned on current line 3 is still `() => {}`. The base-to-head diff shows this PR removed `socket.off("message", handler)`, so cleanup still leaves the listener attached.
